description: Bulk grant/revoke reviewer feedback access in ONE all-or-nothing transaction (max 200 unique people; duplicates dedupe). One ineligible grant target fails the whole batch with nothing written. Receipt-backed. Requires job_feedback:write.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_job_feedback_access_bulk
